notes_for_editor: The two listings agree: a cabin (not a tower), built in the 1920s, gone by the 1950s. Neither names a builder, design, staffing, fires or removal cause, so none is in the story. Two web searches found no Siuslaw or Lincoln County history for this site. A search snippet, not fetched and not cited, listed a Rocky Point summit in Lincoln County at 2,782 ft on the USGS Stott Mountain map, against the register's 2,890 ft. The editor may want to check the map. Event years 1920 and 1950 are placeholders for decades (see notes) and should not be read as exact dates. The name is shared with us-or-rocky-point-2 (Columbia County, Oregon Department of Forestry), which is a different site. Access is left unset (record says unknown).
